rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering for matters concerning government spending, revenue, or the treasury.

example.english: The government needs to cut fiscal spending this year.
example.traditional: 政府今年要削減財政開支。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gam1 nin4 jiu3 soek3 gaam2 coi4 zing3 hoi1 zi1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a fiscal year rather than for fiscal matters in general.

example.english: The company did not give raises this fiscal year.
example.traditional: 呢個財政年度公司冇加人工。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 coi4 zing3 nin4 dou6 gung1 si1 mou5 gaa1 jan4 gung1
